messages.subject: calling newbyrids.exe
parts:
Dear dartR gurus - thank you for an excellent workshop last week!
I wish to ask for your help with running new hybrids and have been hitting an error when trying to call the .exe file within the R script.  I have tried calling the file from multiple locations to see if that is the issue but the same error occurs in that the software is not being found.  In the case below I installed the file in a folder in the c drive.  the file that i downloaded from github is called newhybrids.exe.
thank you for your help!

> m <- gl.nhybrids(gl10, + p0=NULL, p1=NULL, + nhyb.directory = "C:/NewHybsPC/", # Specify as necessary + outpath="~/R/Newhybridoutput", # Specify as necessary, usually getwd() [= workspace] + BurnIn=100, + sweeps=100, + verbose=3) Starting gl.nhybrids Processing genlight object with SNP data No parental population specified Selecting 200 random loci Converting data to NewHybrids format Adding sequential number Writing the NewHybrids input file ~/R/Newhybridoutput/nhyb.txt NumIndivs 41 NumLoci 200 Digits 1 Format Lumped Windows operating system Error in gl.nhybrids(gl10, p0 = NULL, p1 = NULL, nhyb.directory = "C:/NewHybsPC/", : Fatal Error: New Hybrids executable not found in C:\NewHybsPC\ ; required
